beginner.title: Get started with BandLab
beginner.outcome: You can: set up BandLab, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Record cleanly
beginner.outcome: You can: record clear audio with BandLab
beginner.practice: Record a 1-minute voice or instrument take with good levels

beginner.title: Edit and arrange
beginner.outcome: You can: cut, arrange and tidy recordings
beginner.practice: Edit a rough recording into a clean 2-minute piece

intermediate.title: Mix for clarity
intermediate.outcome: You can: balance and polish a mix
intermediate.practice: Mix a short track or podcast episode

intermediate.title: Export for every platform
intermediate.outcome: You can: deliver the right file for each destination
intermediate.practice: Export versions for streaming, podcast and video

intermediate.title: Signature skills in BandLab
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make BandLab distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced BandLab
expert.outcome: You can: use BandLab's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Produce a full release
expert.outcome: You can: take a project from idea to release
expert.practice: Produce and release a complete track or episode

expert.title: Integrate BandLab into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect BandLab with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect BandLab to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use BandLab well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use BandLab" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
